{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute crude difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
crude_difference = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print required values
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of patients in control arm: {df[df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]}")
print(f"Treatment response rate: {treatment_response_rate:.3f}")
print(f"Control response rate: {control_response_rate:.3f}")
print(f"Crude difference in proportions (treatment - control): {crude_difference:.3f}")

# Return the crude difference
crude_difference"}
